bottlenecks: Rule-based confidence is still heuristic: min(1.0, len(recommendations)*0.2+0.3) — not a calibrated model probability, unreliable for ranking or thresholding
Rule-based feature importance is hardcoded to mirror rule-trigger weights (0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1) rather than learned from data
ML path priority_score = 1.0 - predicted_yield is a crude heuristic — no learned mapping from yield to priority, no multi-objective trade-off
API gateway authentication defaults to open: when auth=None, _authenticate returns {sub:anonymous, roles:[admin]} — fail-open design
TenantRegistry uses in-memory dicts/lists for all state — no persistence, no horizontal scalability, data lost on restart
AuditLogger stores all events in an in-memory list with no eviction — unbounded memory growth in long-running processes
Rate limiting state is per-process in-memory in both api_gateway.py (_rate_limit_hits) and security.py (_rate_limits) — not shared across workers
No caching layer for recommendations — identical FarmState inputs recompute from scratch every time
Dashboard broadcast() iterates all WebSocket clients sequentially with no backpressure — a slow client can delay updates for all others
list_readings and list_commands in api_gateway filter only by farm_id, not tenant_id — cross-tenant farm_id guess could leak data
No async support in DecisionEngine — recommend() is synchronous and blocks the event loop when called from async FastAPI endpoints
DecisionEngine ML path is disconnected from ModelRegistry — no version selection, no rollback, no canary deployment
No model performance monitoring — no logging of prediction accuracy, no alerting when model degrades, no automated retraining triggers
No pagination on list endpoints (list_readings, list_commands, list_farms) — unbounded response size
No circuit breaker for downstream ML model calls — model failure cascades to API gateway
No request deduplication — identical sensor readings can be submitted multiple times
No semantic validation beyond Pydantic — sensor readings accept any float value without range checks
ABTestManager exists but is not wired to DecisionEngine — experiments cannot influence recommendation strategy
DriftDetector exists but is not wired to model serving — drift does not trigger retraining or alerting
No WebSocket endpoint for real-time recommendations — clients must poll
No API versioning strategy beyond /api/v1 — no deprecation or migration path
No ETag or conditional request support — clients cannot cache responses efficiently
No request batching endpoint for sensor readings — each reading is a separate POST
No OpenAPI customization or documentation beyond auto-generated schema
No multi-tenant isolation in Dashboard — single FarmState shared across all tenants
No growth-stage awareness — recommendations use same thresholds regardless of crop growth stage
No temporal reasoning — recommendations don't consider time of day, season, or weather forecast
No constraint checking — recommendations don't consider resource constraints (water availability, labor, budget)
No recommendation ranking — recommendations are an unordered list with no scoring or prioritization
No explanation generation beyond feature importance — no natural language rationale for recommendations
No personalization per farm or crop type — same thresholds for all crops and conditions
missing_algorithms: No reinforcement learning or multi-armed bandit — no exploration/exploitation mechanism to learn which recommendations improve outcomes over time
No causal inference — no uplift modeling or counterfactual analysis to estimate the true effect of a recommendation
No feedback loop — RecommendationResult has no outcome tracking, so the system cannot measure whether recommendations were followed or whether they worked
No canary or shadow deployment — no mechanism to serve a new model version to a subset of traffic for validation before full rollout
No feature store persistence layer — FeatureEngine computes GDD, VPD, and trend features but there is no persistence, versioning, or retrieval layer for serving features at inference time
No online/incremental learning support — models cannot be updated incrementally with new data, only batch training
No hyperparameter tuning — no grid search, random search, or Bayesian optimization for model hyperparameters
No multi-objective optimization — no Pareto frontier or weighted sum approach for trading off water usage vs yield vs cost
No constraint satisfaction or linear programming — no solver for irrigation scheduling, fertilizer planning, or resource allocation under constraints
No natural language explanation generation — no template-based or learned rationale for why a recommendation was made
No recommendation ranking or scoring model — no learning-to-rank approach for ordering recommendations by expected utility
No ensemble model selection or weighting optimization — ensemble uses simple averaging, not learned weights or stacking
No model performance monitoring or automated retraining triggers — no scheduled evaluation or accuracy-based retraining
No drift detection integration with model serving — DriftDetector exists but is not connected to the recommendation pipeline
No A/B testing integration with recommender — ABTestManager exists but experiments cannot influence DecisionEngine behavior
No counterfactual evaluation — no method to estimate what would have happened without a recommendation
No contextual bandit — no context-aware exploration for recommendation strategies
No Bayesian optimization — no efficient exploration of recommendation policy space
No model explainability beyond feature importance — no SHAP, LIME, or attention-based explanations
No automated feature selection — FeatureEngine computes all features regardless of relevance
No transfer learning — models trained on one farm/crop cannot leverage knowledge from other farms/crops
benchmark_gaps: No offline evaluation metrics for recommendations — no precision, recall, NDCG, or mean reciprocal rank computed against historical outcomes
No online metrics tracking — no measurement of recommendation click-through rate, action completion rate, or user satisfaction
No model performance baselines — no stored baseline accuracy for yield prediction or anomaly detection to compare new models against
No load or stress testing for the API gateway — no benchmarks for requests/sec, latency percentiles, or breaking points under concurrent load
No regression tests for model accuracy — tests verify model training/prediction mechanics but do not assert minimum accuracy thresholds on fixed datasets
No fairness or bias testing — no checks for disparate recommendation quality across crop types, farm sizes, or geographic regions
No latency SLO tests — no assertions that recommend() or API endpoints complete within a target latency budget
No throughput benchmarks for the audit logger — no measurement of events/sec capacity or chain verification cost at scale
No chaos or failure-mode tests — no tests for behavior when ML model is untrained, when feature store is unavailable, or when audit logger fails
No integration tests exercising the full path from sensor reading → alert → recommendation → notification — each subsystem is tested in isolation
No benchmark for ensemble vs single-model performance — no measurement of whether ensemble actually improves over individual models
No benchmark for forecasting accuracy — no comparison of ExponentialSmoother against baselines (naive, seasonal naive, ARIMA)
No benchmark for drift detection sensitivity — no measurement of false positive/negative rates for PSI and KS tests
No benchmark for A/B testing statistical power — no measurement of minimum sample size or experiment duration
No benchmark for notification delivery latency — no measurement of end-to-end alert-to-notification time
No benchmark for GPS spoofing detection accuracy — no measurement of detection rate vs false positive rate
No benchmark for rate limiting accuracy — no measurement of allowed vs rejected requests under various load patterns
No benchmark for audit chain verification performance — no measurement of verify_chain() cost as event count grows
No benchmark for cross-tenant isolation — no measurement of performance degradation with increasing tenant count
No benchmark for recommendation diversity — no measurement of recommendation variety across similar farm states
